Child 3 of 4 splitting umbrella beadrs-12b78650. Depends on child 2 (checkpoint republished) so doctor validates the post-flush state.

Parent acceptance: validate with bead doctor — read-only first; --repair only for its documented non-destructive fixes (stale temp files, checkpoint views, missing indexes). Never a schema/hostile repair, never a store reinit.

Use the repo build /home/coding/target/debug/bead.

- bead doctor (read-only, no --repair) run; output recorded in this child's notes
- bead list --ready works (the fleet frontier is readable) and bead show beadrs-12b78650 resolves against the live store

- Schema version is current for this binary and no command reports a missing table
